'''Parein II 4''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]]-inhabited fourth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Parein II/Legends|Parein II]] in the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' lists the fourth moon of Parein II as uninhabited.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|13|Parein II}}</ref>
